feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 7:56am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 17 June 2026 at 7:55am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area early evening, increasing 4 or 5 in all waters late evening, decreasing 2 to 4 in Liverpool bay for a time overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate late evening.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at first, soon clearing. Areas of mist, mostly confined to the south of the area, remaining until early evening. Outbreaks of rain, heavy at times, developing later tonight in the west of the area.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain and poor in mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area during Thursday morning, then in all waters Thursday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate in all waters by Thursday afternoon.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, heavy at times, becoming patchier Thursday afternoon. Mist and fog in the south of the area Thursday evening, spreading to central and western areas overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Very poor in fog later.
